description:
The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana was launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh on 1st April 2019. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families of farmers who suffer from accidental deaths or disabilities. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased farmers receive adequate financial support during their time of need. 

The scheme seeks to alleviate the economic burden on families who lose their primary breadwinner due to unforeseen circumstances. 

Under this initiative, the government provides a compensation amount of ₹5 lakh to the family of the deceased farmer. 

In the case of permanent disability caused by an accident, the affected farmer is entitled to receive ₹3 lakh as compensation. 

The scheme is designed to cover all farmers in Uttar Pradesh, regardless of their landholding size. 

Eligibility for the Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is primarily based on the status of the applicant as a farmer. 

Applicants must be registered as farmers in Uttar Pradesh to qualify for the benefits. 

There are no specific age limits set for the applicants under this scheme. 

However, it is essential that the applicant is a resident of Uttar Pradesh. 

The application process for the Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is straightforward and user-friendly. 

Farmers or their family members can apply for the scheme through the online portal set up by the Uttar Pradesh government. 

The application form can be accessed on the official website of the Department of Agriculture, Uttar Pradesh. 

To apply, the following documents are required: a copy of the farmer's identity proof, a copy of the landholding certificate, and a copy of the death certificate or disability certificate. 

Additionally, a bank account statement or passbook is needed to facilitate the transfer of funds. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of compensation is typically processed within 30 days of the application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Uttar Pradesh. 

Farmers can contact the local agriculture office for assistance with the application process. 

The contact details for the Department of Agriculture can be found on their official website. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to support farmers and improve their livelihoods. 

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to ensuring the welfare of farmers in the state. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has benefited thousands of families across Uttar Pradesh. 

The government has reported that over 10,000 families have received compensation under this scheme since its launch. 

This initiative is crucial in a state where agriculture is the primary source of income for a significant portion of the population. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the financial stress that families face after the loss of a farmer. 

In addition to the financial assistance, the government provides awareness programs to educate farmers about the scheme. 

These programs are conducted at the village level to ensure maximum outreach. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is part of a series of welfare schemes aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of farmers in Uttar Pradesh. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹200 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This allocation demonstrates the government's commitment to supporting farmers and their families. 

The scheme is also aligned with the central government's initiatives aimed at improving the welfare of farmers across India. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is an essential step towards ensuring that farmers have a safety net in case of unforeseen circumstances. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have expressed gratitude for the timely assistance. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure that it meets its objectives. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme and identify areas for improvement. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is an example of how targeted welfare schemes can make a significant difference in the lives of farmers. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also promotes a sense of security among farming families. 

The government encourages farmers to take advantage of this scheme and apply for the benefits. 

Awareness campaigns are ongoing to ensure that all eligible farmers are informed about the scheme. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana represents a proactive approach by the Uttar Pradesh government to address the challenges faced by farmers. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the vital role that farmers play in the state's economy. 

By providing financial support, the government aims to empower farmers and their families. 

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of farmers in Uttar Pradesh. 

Overall, the Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is a critical initiative that underscores the importance of supporting farmers in times of crisis. 

The scheme is a vital resource for families who have lost their primary earners due to accidents. 

As such, it plays a crucial role in promoting the welfare and stability of farming communities in Uttar Pradesh. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the scheme and ensuring that it effectively serves its intended purpose. 

Through this initiative, the Uttar Pradesh government aims to create a more resilient agricultural sector. 

The Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana is a significant step towards achieving that goal.
